text: Unit 6, page 76, reading. An extraordinary teenager. Isaac Beech is 14 years old. His nickname is Zach. He goes to a special school in Manchester in the UK. It's called Chetam's, and it's a famous music school. Zach plays the piano and the violin. He's very good. Zach studies regular subjects like English, science, and math at the school, but he has music classes every day, too. Some students go home when they finish class at Chetems, but Zach can't. His parents and two sisters are in Bristol, 220 kilometers from Manchester. So Chetems is Zach's school and his home. He studies there, he has breakfast, lunch, and dinner there, and he goes to bed there. There are three other boys in Zach's room at school. He thinks it's fun. On Saturday mornings, Zach gets up and goes to school. There aren't classes, but he plays the violin in the school orchestra. He has free time in the afternoon. On Sundays, Zach does his homework and plays sports. In the evenings, he watches TV and uses the computer. He has 200 cyber friends.
